description: Alphabet Q3 2024 earnings call CEO remarks (blog.google) - "more than a quarter of all new code at Google is generated by AI, then reviewed and accepted by engineers"
Business Insider (from leaked internal documents) - internal model Goose, "descendant of Gemini", 25 years of engineering expertise, 28k token context window
GitHub research blog (Kalliamvakou) - 95 recruited developers; Copilot group 55% faster (1h11m vs 2h41m) on one HTTP-server task
arXiv:2302.06590 (Peng, Kalliamvakou, Cihon, Demirer) - controlled experiment, treatment completed task 55.8% faster; preprint
arXiv:2606.00438 (Heilman, Kyllo, Murphy-Hill; Microsoft) - observational, 16,223 Cloud+AI engineers, Feb-Dec 2025; +40.5% PRs in highest vs zero Copilot-usage weeks; preprint, not peer-reviewed
